artist.name: DJ PANTS
artist.bio: DJ Pants is the alias of Aditya Mehta, a multidisciplinary artist and live sound engineer. He plays Balearic beat, disco, boogie, house and street soul, moving from relaxed daytime sets to club energy. He is on the Magnetic Fields artist roster.

eras.sound: Balearic-tinged new-age electronica and bass-heavy house
